title: An open access NLP dataset for Arabic dialects : data collection, labeling, and model construction
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and evaluation of a dataset for Arabic dialects for NLP tasks such as dialect detection, topic detection, and sentiment analysis. The topics covered (Politics, Health, Social, Sport, Economics) do not include religion, morals, or ethics, and the paper does not contain any component for evaluating or benchmarking these concepts.
